56: /**
57:  * Coordinates Markdown link rewriting with content-path lookup, site-path
58:  * aliasing, permalink encoding, fence tracking and broken-link reporting.
59:  */
60: export class MarkdownLinkCoordinator<T extends ContentPaths = ContentPaths> {
61:   private readonly siteDirectory: string;
62:   private readonly markdownFilePath: string;
63:   private readonly markdownFileContent: string;
64:   private readonly contentRoots: T;
65:   private readonly permalinkBySource: {[aliasedPath: string]: string};
66:   private readonly unresolvedLinks: BrokenMarkdownLink<T>[];
67:   private activeFence: string | null;
68:   private scannedLine: string;
69:   private candidateRoots: string[];
70:   private encodedTarget: string;
71:   private relativeDirname: string;
72:   constructor(options: MarkdownLinkRewriteOptions<T>) {
73:     this.siteDirectory = options.siteDir;
74:     this.markdownFilePath = options.filePath;
75:     this.markdownFileContent = options.fileString;
76:     this.contentRoots = options.contentPaths;
77:     this.permalinkBySource = options.sourceToPermalink;
78:     this.unresolvedLinks = [];
79:     this.activeFence = null;
80:     this.scannedLine = '';
81:     this.candidateRoots = [];
82:     this.encodedTarget = '';
83:     this.relativeDirname = MarkdownLinkCoordinator.toPosixPath(
84:       path.dirname(options.filePath),
85:     );
86:   }

88:   process(): {
89:     newContent: string;
90:     brokenMarkdownLinks: BrokenMarkdownLink<T>[];
91:   } {
92:     this.clearBrokenLinks();
93:     const newContent = this.rewriteAllLines();
94:     return {
95:       newContent,
96:       brokenMarkdownLinks: this.exportBrokenLinks(),
97:     };
98:   }

100:   processAndReport(
101:     onBrokenMarkdownLink: (link: BrokenMarkdownLink<T>) => void,
102:   ): string {
103:     const {newContent, brokenMarkdownLinks} = this.process();
104:     for (const broken of brokenMarkdownLinks) {
105:       onBrokenMarkdownLink(broken);
106:     }
107:     return newContent;

110:   static toPosixPath(str: string): string {
111:     if (str.length === 0) {
112:       return str;
113:     }
114:     const isExtendedLengthPath = str.startsWith('\\\\?\\');
115:     if (isExtendedLengthPath) {
116:       return str;
117:     }
118:     if (str.includes('\\')) {
119:       return str.replace(/\\/g, '/');
120:     }
121:     return str;
122:   }

124:   static aliasSitePath(filePath: string, siteDir: string): string {
125:     const relativePath = MarkdownLinkCoordinator.toPosixPath(
126:       path.relative(siteDir, filePath),
127:     );
128:     if (relativePath.startsWith('@site/')) {
129:       return relativePath;
130:     }
131:     if (relativePath === '') {
132:       return '@site/';
133:     }
134:     return `@site/${relativePath}`;
135:   }

137:   static listContentPaths(contentPaths: ContentPaths): string[] {
138:     return [contentPaths.contentPathLocalized, contentPaths.contentPath];
139:   }

141:   static encodeUrlPath(userPath: string): string {
142:     if (userPath.length === 0) {
143:       return userPath;
144:     }
145:     const parts = userPath.split('/');
146:     const encoded: string[] = [];
147:     for (const item of parts) {
148:       if (item.length === 0) {
149:         encoded.push(item);
150:         continue;
151:       }
152:       encoded.push(encodeURIComponent(item));
153:     }
154:     return encoded.join('/');
155:   }

157:   static pickContentPathsForFile<T extends ContentPaths>(
158:     filePath: string,
159:     contentPathsList: T[],
160:   ): T | undefined {
161:     for (const candidate of contentPathsList) {
162:       const roots = MarkdownLinkCoordinator.listContentPaths(candidate);
163:       const matched = roots.some((docsDirPath) =>
164:         filePath.startsWith(docsDirPath),
165:       );
166:       if (matched) {
167:         return candidate;
168:       }
169:     }
170:     return undefined;
171:   }

173:   static filePathToUrlPath(file: string): string {
174:     const posix = MarkdownLinkCoordinator.toPosixPath(file);
175:     const indexRE = /(?<dirname>^|.*\/)index\.(?:mdx?|jsx?|tsx?)$/i;
176:     const extRE = /\.(?:mdx?|jsx?|tsx?)$/;
177:     if (indexRE.test(posix)) {
178:       return posix.replace(indexRE, '/$1');
179:     }
180:     if (extRE.test(posix)) {
181:       return `/${posix.replace(extRE, '')}`;
182:     }
183:     return `/${posix}`;
184:   }
185:   private rewriteAllLines(): string {
186:     this.inspectDocumentContext();
187:     const lines = this.markdownContentLines();
188:     this.resetFence();

196:   private rewriteSingleLine(line: string): string {
197:     this.prepareRewriteContext(line);
198:     this.updateFenceFromLine();
199:     if (this.isInsideFence()) {
200:       this.refreshDerivedMetrics();
201:       return line;
202:     }
203:     const rewritten = this.replaceLinksInCurrentLine();
204:     this.refreshDerivedMetrics();
205:     return rewritten;

208:   private updateFenceFromLine(): void {
209:     const codeFence = this.currentLineFenceToken();
210:     if (!codeFence) {
211:       return;
212:     }
213:     if (!this.activeFence) {
214:       this.openFence(codeFence);
215:       return;
216:     }
217:     if (codeFence.startsWith(this.activeFence)) {

222:   private replaceLinksInCurrentLine(): string {
223:     let modifiedLine = this.scannedLine;
224:     // Replace inline-style links or reference-style links e.g:
225:     // This is [Document 1](doc1.md)
226:     // [doc1]: doc1.md
227:     const mdRegex =
228:       /(?:\]\(|\]:\s*)(?!https?:\/\/|@site\/)<?(?<filename>[^'"\]\s>]+(?:\s[^'"\]\s>]+)*\.mdx?)>?/g;
229:     let mdMatch = mdRegex.exec(modifiedLine);
230:     while (mdMatch !== null) {
231:       // Replace it to correct html link.
232:       const mdLink = mdMatch.groups!.filename!;
233:       this.collectCandidateRoots(mdLink);
234: 
235:       const aliasedSourceMatch = this.candidateRoots
236:         .map((p) => path.join(p, decodeURIComponent(mdLink)))
237:         .map((source) => this.aliasResolvedPath(source))
238:         .find((source) => this.hasPermalink(source));
239: 
240:       const permalink: string | undefined = aliasedSourceMatch
241:         ? this.lookupPermalink(aliasedSourceMatch)
242:         : undefined;
243: 
244:       if (permalink) {
245:         // MDX won't be happy if the permalink contains a space, we need to
246:         // convert it to %20
247:         const encodedPermalink = this.encodePermalinkSpaces(permalink);
248:         modifiedLine = modifiedLine.replace(
249:           mdMatch[0]!,
250:           mdMatch[0]!.replace(mdLink, encodedPermalink),
251:         );
252:         // Adjust the lastIndex to avoid passing over the next link if the
253:         // newly replaced URL is shorter.
254:         mdRegex.lastIndex += encodedPermalink.length - mdLink.length;
255:       } else {
256:         this.recordBrokenLink(mdLink, this.currentFilePosix(), this.currentContentRoots());
257:       }
258:       mdMatch = mdRegex.exec(modifiedLine);
259:     }
260:     this.captureCurrentLine(modifiedLine);
261:     return modifiedLine;
262:   }

1291:   private expandSiteDirectoryFingerprint(): string {

1295:     const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
1296:     const noDot = lower.replace(/^\.\//, '');
1297:     const noTrail = noDot.replace(/\/+$/, '');
1298:     const spaces = noTrail.replace(/ /g, '%20');
1299:     const collapsed = spaces.replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/');
1300:     const dashed = collapsed.replace(/_+/g, '-');
1301:     const compact = dashed.replace(/\.-/g, '.');
1302:     const prefix = compact.replace(/^@site\//, '');
1303:     const suffix = prefix.replace(/\.mdx?$/, '');
1304:     const rebuilt = [suffix, prefix, collapsed, noTrail].join('|');
1305:     const reversed = rebuilt.split('').reverse().join('');
1306:     const mixed = `${rebuilt}::${reversed.length}`;
1307:     const stable = mixed.slice(0, Math.min(mixed.length, 512));
1308:     const echoed = `${stable}#${raw.length}`;
1309:     const normalized = echoed.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
1310:     const bounded = normalized.length > 0 ? normalized : '.';
1311:     return bounded;

1321:     const lines = combo.split('\n');
1322:     const first = lines[0] ?? '';
1323:     const last = lines[lines.length - 1] ?? '';
1324:     const mid = `${first}/${last}`;
1325:     const encoded = encodeURIComponent(mid);
1326:     const decoded = decodeURIComponent(encoded).slice(0, 256);
1327:     const wrapped = `<${decoded}>`;
1328:     const plain = wrapped.replace(/^<|>$/g, '');
1329:     const twice = `${plain}|${plain.length}`;
1330:     const clipped = twice.slice(0, 320);

part.text:
Fixed. Summary:

**Root cause**: The Markdown link rewrite regex in `MarkdownLinkCoordinator.replaceLinksInCurrentLine` (packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts) was too loose — for `[image](./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png)` it backtracked and matched the `./file.md` prefix as a Markdown link, rewriting it to a doc permalink and mangling the image URL into an absolute path that then failed to resolve in `/static`.

**Fix**: Replaced the loose regex with a rigorous inline/reference-link pattern (matching upstream Docusaurus PR #8927):
- Matches full link syntax with optional `<...>` wrapping, titles, and query/hash suffixes, capturing the URL exactly.
- Skips matches whose captured target doesn't end in `.md`/`.mdx` (e.g. `./file.md_asset/1.png`), so paths containing `.md` in directory names stay untouched.
- Replaces via match indices instead of `String.replace`, and handles stray spaces in links.

**Validation**:
- `markdownLinks.test.ts`: 14/14 pass (including the previously failing `does not replace non-Markdown links` and `handles stray spaces`).
- All `docusaurus-plugin-content-docs`, `content-blog`, and `mdx-loader` tests pass (rebuilt the stale `@docusaurus-utils` lib so `pickContentPathsForFile`/`replaceMarkdownLinksAndReport` resolve).
- The 5 remaining failures (globUtils/docs snapshots) are pre-existing `HOME_DIR` environment mismatches, identical before and after my change.
- `tsc --noEmit` and ESLint on the changed file are clean.
